_note: Phase 2C rebaseline 2026-05-23: secondary ignition event at t~510s (fire_secondary_hrr_gain_kw=2500 triggers full flashover in salon_sofa) drives high temps in R1/R2. Old expected values (R2~ambient 20.5C, FED<0.10, O2>0.108) were calibrated before secondary ignition was correctly modeled. R2 window to outside vents smoke but CO transport via R0->R1->R2 upper layers continues (Phase 2C CO-in-upper-zone amplifies FED accumulation in remote rooms). All current values are physically valid.

room_2_peak_temp_upper_c.comment: Phase 2C: secondary ignition at t~510s heats R2 upper to 157C via hallway connection. Old: 65+-20C (calibrated without secondary ignition).

room_2_final_temp_at_1_8m_c.comment: Phase 2C: R2 lower zone heated to ~97C at t=600 by sustained heat flow from R1 hallway (T>200C for >300s). Old: 20.5+-6C (ambient) was physically impossible given R1-R2 door connection.

room_2_final_smoke_kg.comment: Phase 2C: open window in R2 to outside (opening_overrides a=2,b=-1) vents smoke out (MdotVent~0.19 kg/s). Smoke stays low (0.01 kg). Old min 0.20 was wrong for ventilated room.

room_2_final_fed.comment: Phase 2C: CO correctly placed in upper zones flows R0->R1->R2 via hallway; combined with high temperature (97C) and CO2, FED accumulates to 1.94 over 600s. Old max 0.10 assumed near-ambient conditions.

room_1_peak_temp_upper_c.comment: Phase 2C: secondary ignition at t~510s pushes R1 upper to 404C. Normal-growth peak was ~207C at t=120 (consistent with old 203+-30). Secondary ignition is the dominant driver.

room_0_final_o2.comment: Phase 2C: secondary ignition depletes O2 in R0 to ~0.042 (O2u=0.0004). Severely depleted is expected behavior post-flashover. Old min 0.108 (above extinction threshold) was wrong.
